reviews.review: This is a another review from a guy that wishes we had a neutral option. I bought this game simply on the hopes for more Dark Souls goodness, but with guns. It was just mediocre, not terrible, not good. Played it for about 10 hours and then abandoned it. Didn't even bother to review it at the time. And then I played Remnant: From The Ashes. Don't buy this game, go buy that game, it's worthy of a thumbs up.

Dark souls with guns, and some melee weapons, while the guns do a great job, u rarely focus on the hand to hand aspect and that is a crying shame, this game seems like a stepping stone or rather an inspiration to REMNANT : FROM THE ASHES, an all around supped up version of this game, but still, this game has a ton more atmosphere and lore and a really bleak setting that the other game doesn't achieve.
Few things annoy here and there, u can't crouch, and that is weird, the snipers are worth nothing , and for some reason, the enemies can't spring traps that are made for you , and that is also weird.
But, it is a good game, and it is challenging and has some really good atmosphere and a ton of exploration and some really interesting NPCs here and there.
Pick it up when on sale , but get the combo deal for extra content, it is a solid 8/10 game that really does a lot of things well but has a few issues but non game braking to make it a problem.
Very rough in some parts but overall a worthwhile experience
